surfaces.label: Wiring, unit of work, and learning containment
surfaces.notes: Same repository/unit-of-work instance, same datasource, PROPAGATION_REQUIRED, and no inbound mutable learning-store dependency or write path.
surfaces.riskArea: Atomic transaction wiring and implicit learning side effects

surfaces.label: JDBC snapshot and exact correlation
surfaces.notes: One JdbcTemplate query and one SQL statement snapshot; exact eventId correlation and fail-closed orphan/conflict/ambiguity semantics.
surfaces.riskArea: READ COMMITTED torn reads, orphan ambiguity, and cross-tenant correlation

surfaces.label: Validation and strict JSON
surfaces.notes: Validation and canonicalization precede duplicate resolution; top-level JSON requires one object root, strict duplicate detection, and EOF.
surfaces.riskArea: Duplicate shortcut bypass and parser ambiguity

surfaces.label: In-memory rollback parity
surfaces.notes: Synchronized unit-of-work snapshots and restores envelope, events, correlation index, and insertion order.
surfaces.riskArea: Partial state, concurrent same-key handling, and correlation-index rollback

surfaces.label: Correlation lookup index candidate
surfaces.notes: No dedicated correlation_id index exists, but no production-sized EXPLAIN, row-count, or service-impact evidence proves a security vulnerability; ingress is authenticated/rate-limited and JDBC is default-disabled. Retained as a known capacity limitation.
surfaces.riskArea: Potential resource consumption as feedback-event volume grows

surfaces.label: Embedded textual JSON duplicate-key candidate
surfaces.notes: The ordinary readTree helper behavior is unchanged from the base revision, and this diff neither introduced nor expanded the path; no disclosure, privilege, learning, or cross-tenant impact was proven.
surfaces.riskArea: Potential forbidden-field scan ambiguity inside a JSON string
